headline: US stocks fall further as tech shares plunge amid growing AI investment fears
label: NEWS
caption:
Wall Street took another hit as tech stocks tumbled amid rising concerns over artificial intelligence investments 📉

All three main US stock market indices fell in early trading, with the tech dominated Nasdaq shedding over 2% according to BBC reports. Shares in major firms including Nvidia, Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Microsoft and Meta dropped sharply.

Nvidia saw its share price slide by 8% following recent volatility surrounding boss Jensen Huang and broader market jitters. Analysts say investors are questioning whether the massive sums being poured into artificial intelligence will ultimately pay off.

Goldman Sachs expects AI investment to exceed 1 trillion dollars in 2026, though Wall Street remains cautious about near term returns. The latest market decline also coincides with new US tariffs announced under President Donald Trump.
